app.name: Celina Plains Phase 1 HOA
app.officialFooter: Official system of Celina Plains Phase 1 HOA
app.playfulFooter: Official portal for Celina Plains Phase 1 — dues, payments, and community finance.
app.demoBanner: DEMO DATA — Sample residents and lots for local testing only. Not live HOA records.
app.cloudBanner: CLOUD — Records are saved in Firebase and shared across signed-in devices. This is still demo data, not live HOA records.

landing.sealAlt: Celina Plains Homeowners' Association, Imus. HLURB Reg. No. 14844
landing.title: A quieter way home.
landing.lead: Dues, payments, notices, and this year’s vote, kept in one resident ledger.
landing.sampleNote: Sample scenes, shown for atmosphere. These are not photographs of the subdivision.
landing.streetAlt: Entrance sign, Celina Plains Subdivision Phase 1
landing.living: A room meant for staying in
landing.livingAlt: A closer view of a home
landing.housesAlt: Houses on the street at dusk
landing.gate: A gate that still feels like home
landing.duesBody: See what is due, and what is already settled.
landing.payBody: Send the screenshot on Messenger. The treasurer confirms it with an official receipt number.
landing.voteBody: When voting is open, an assigned lot casts a single secret ballot.

login.title: Sign in
login.lead: Sign in to manage dues, payments, and HOA records for Celina Plains Phase 1.
login.needSeed: No users found. Load demo data on the login screen first.

register.title: Apply
register.lead: Send your details. An officer verifies the application before you can sign in.
register.lotHint: Use the lot code on your papers. The lot opens after an officer verifies you.
register.privacy: I agree to the privacy notice.
register.sent: Application sent. An officer will verify it before you can sign in.
register.haveAccount: Already have a sign-in? Sign in
register.passwordShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.body: We collect only what the HOA needs to run day-to-day work: your name, lot, and contact details. Money records stay with your lot. You can ask the Treasurer about your data anytime. By continuing, you agree to this notice (RA 10173 baseline).
privacy.required: Please accept the privacy notice to continue.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.activityLine_one: You have {{count}} HOA item to watch today.
dashboard.activityLine_other: You have {{count}} HOA items to watch today.
dashboard.promoBody: Send the screenshot to the treasurer on Messenger. They confirm it with an OR number.
dashboard.communityNote: High-level totals only. You will not see other households’ personal payment details.
dashboard.yearStrip: This year’s dues and the next gathering

lots.title: Lots / households
lots.lead: Manage lots for Celina Plains Phase 1. Lot count and codes are configurable.
lots.applicationsLead: Verify a homeowner before they can sign in.
lots.addResidentLead: The resident signs in with the username and password you set.
lots.empty: No lots yet. Add a lot or load demo data.
lots.myLotsLead: Your household lot details and current balance.
lots.noLinked: No lot linked to your account yet. Ask the Treasurer.
lots.drawerHint: Tap a lot to open the detail drawer.

announcements.title: Announcements
announcements.lead: Community notices from officers and the treasurer.
announcements.eventDateHint: Leave blank when the notice is not for a date.

documents.title: Documents
documents.lead: House rules, the deed of restrictions, and meeting minutes.
documents.empty: Nothing posted on this shelf yet.

pay.gcashBody: Scan the treasurer’s QR. Send the screenshot on Messenger.
pay.gcashMissing: The treasurer’s GCash QR has not been added to this site yet.

feedback.title: Complaints & suggestions
feedback.lead: Tell the HOA what needs fixing — or what would make the community better.
feedback.subject: Subject

plans.title: HOA plans & progress
plans.lead: See what the association is working on — gates, lights, pathways, and more.

dues.title: Dues
dues.lead: Monthly HOA dues per lot. Amounts and penalties come from Settings (configurable).
dues.payHint: Unpaid or partial periods show a Pay now button — tap to open the payment form with the balance filled in.

payments.title: Payments
payments.lead: Record the payment here. Send the screenshot to the treasurer on Messenger. The treasurer assigns the OR number after they see it.
payments.messengerNote: Send the screenshot to the treasurer on Messenger. This form records the amount and reference only.
payments.proofRequired: Send the screenshot to the treasurer on Messenger.
payments.proofHint: The screenshot stays on Messenger. It is not stored in this portal.
payments.orRequired: OR number is required to verify.
payments.submitted: Payment recorded. Send the screenshot to the treasurer on Messenger.
payments.cannotViewOther: You cannot view another household’s payment.
payments.payingForPeriod: Paying for dues period {{period}}. Amount is prefilled from the remaining balance.

expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.lead: Post HOA expenses. Void with a reason instead of deleting.
expenses.voidConfirm: Void this expense? This cannot be undone except by a new correcting entry.

reports.title: Finance report
reports.lead: Collections vs expenses for transparency. Homeowners see community totals only.
reports.detailedNote: Cash ledger lines are treasurer-only. Officers can still view collections progress.
reports.progressLead: Verified payments received each month vs the expected dues target for active lots.
reports.collectionRateHint: Share of the monthly dues target already received.

officers.title: Election of officers
officers.lead: Public list of candidates posted for this year’s election.
officers.blockLead: One candidate for each block, as posted. A dash on the notice is shown as vacant.
officers.secretaryNote: The secretary will be appointed by the elected president.
officers.source: Transcribed from the posted CPI-1 HOA notices. This is the candidate list, not a certified election result.

voting.title: Online voting
voting.lead: One secret ballot per assigned lot. Officers choose who may vote and which block that lot votes in.
voting.assignLead: Check the lots that can vote. The block decides which block leader they vote for. Executive offices are on every eligible ballot.
voting.ballotLead: This lot is assigned to block {{block}}. Vote for each candidate, or abstain.
voting.noLot: No lot is linked to this account.
voting.notAssigned: This lot is not assigned to vote. An officer or the treasurer can add it.
voting.alreadyVoted: Ballot recorded {{when}}. How you voted stays private.
voting.resultsLead: Counts only. Individual ballots are not shown.

settings.title: Settings
settings.lead: Configurable HOA values. Do not hard-code subdivision facts in the app.
settings.seedDemoHint: Creates demo users for each role plus sample lots, dues, and payments. Clearly labeled DEMO.
settings.seedConfirm: Replace current local data with DEMO data?
settings.importConfirm: Import will replace all local data. Continue?

audit.title: Finance audit log
audit.lead: Who changed money records, and when.

errors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this page.
errors.notFoundLead: That path wandered off the subdivision map. Let’s get you back home.
